ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The family's own artifacts disagree on the route key, and the key the participant-facing pages print does not exist. production-field-map.json, participant-instructions.md and the Route: line printed on the pages of both fixtures carry "obligation:track-pathway:KY:ky_void_seal_marijuana_synthetic_salvia:void-and-seal", while product-wiring.json and the MASTER_QUEUE row carry "obligation:track-only:KY:ky_void_seal_marijuana_synthetic_salvia".
